title: Steward-owned Belgium — Incorruptible is 'crucial for the worldwide #StewardOwnership movement'
summary: Steward-owned Belgium (3,127 followers) — an organizing hub for the European Steward Ownership movement — frames Incorruptible alongside Aunnie Patton Power and Erinch Sahan's forthcoming Brave New Capital as the two current pieces of work most crucial for the worldwide Steward Ownership movement. Cites Ries's 'Financial Gravity' and shareholder primacy as the exact dynamics the movement is trying to change. 108 likes.
blockquote: 'Brave New Capital'. This new book by Aunnie Patton Power and Erinch Sahan is, shortly after the successful launch of 'Incorruptible' by Eric Ries, another piece of work that is crucial for the worldwide #StewardOwnership movement.
attribution_title: European Steward Ownership movement hub (3,127 followers)
